article.headline: Yakemchuk breaks late tie in the Senators' 2-1 victory over the Flyers
article.description: — Carter Yakemchuk broke a tie on a power play with 6:59 left and the Ottawa Senators held on to beat the winless Philadelphia Flyers 2-1 on Thursday night.

article.story: OTTAWA, Ontario -- — Carter Yakemchuk broke a tie on a power play with 6:59 left and the Ottawa Senators held on to beat the winless Philadelphia Flyers 2-1 on Thursday night. Nick Cousins opened the scoring for Ottawa at midway through the first period. Matvei Michkov tied it in a power play at 7:46 of the second. Linus Ullmark made 29 saves to help the Senators improve to 3-1-0. Joseph Woll stopped 24 shots for Philadelphia. The Flyers are 0-3-2. Michael Bunting made his Flyers debut after signing with the team Tuesday and Ottawa defenseman Hoyt Stanley made his NHL debut. Up next Flyers: At Boston on Saturday. Senators: Host Nashville on Saturday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
